subject: Habibi
title: What does habibi mean? 'My love' in Arabic, as Love Is Blind: Habibi returns
answer: Habibi is an Arabic term of endearment that literally means "my love" (also "my dear" or "darling"). Habib means a loved one and the ending -i means "my". It is said to partners, children and friends; the feminine form is habibti. Netflix's Love Is Blind: Habibi season 2 starts Nov. 12, 2026.
body:
The meaning depends on who is talking. From a parent to a child it works like "sweetie" or "honey"; between partners it means "my love"; between friends it is closer to "my friend" or "bro". In some places, including Lebanon, people even use it with strangers to soften a conversation. In songs it is sung to both men and women.

Love Is Blind: Habibi is the Arabic version of Netflix's dating show. Season 2 premieres globally on Nov. 12, 2026, with 10 episodes, 27 singles (13 men and 14 women) from across the Arab world, and new hosts Wissam Breidy and Rym Saidi. Season 1 was hosted by Khaled Saqer and Elham Ali and filmed in the UAE and Lebanon.
in_the_news: Season 2 of Netflix's Love Is Blind: Habibi premieres on Nov. 12, 2026, putting the word habibi in front of American viewers again.

faq.a: Habibti is the feminine form: "my love" or "my dear" said to a woman or girl.
It can be, but not always. Parents use it with children and friends use it with each other.
